cohort: 230 low-risk nulliparous women at term with insufficient cervical ripening receiving elective induction
finding: Slow-release vaginal insert and dinoprostone tablet had similar efficacy and safety for elective induction in low-risk nulliparous women at term.
mod_finding: Women with younger maternal age or lower BMI at delivery time may have a better response to dinoprostone and had a significantly higher proportion of hyperstimulation and non-reassuring fetal status.
